additional_info.subject: RE: ID0427041-DC/Si-D/NZ-[Y2 / R5 313057100005] upgrade to V7.0.5 CRM:02681000218
additional_info.body:
Hello Giridhar,
I spoke with the technician on Friday and he confirmed the charger is off.
However, prior to powering off, he was also able to locally confirm the firmware version was 7.0.5, showing it had updated correctly locally, but was not reflecting this in SCB.
Can you please escalate this case to our product experts.
We now have had 3/3 chargers updated from version 6.0.3, that have not shown as online after the firmware update, yet appear to functionally normally locally.
It should be noted that this is happening for the same customer, who has provided their SIM cards.
For this reason, it might be worthwhile understanding if there are any new certificates or FQDNs that have been added after 6.0.3, which are potentially being blocked.
Hey Liz,
Would it be possible to power up these chargers next with either an ethernet or standard (off the shelf) SIM card, instead of the customer SIM card, just to rule this out?
With Kind Regards,
Ferdinand Reisch
Siemens Ltd.
Application Service Engineer
Email: ferdinand.reisch@siemens.com
www.siemens.com.au/emobility
